q: What types of cuisine do you cook?
a: To date, Ammi's Kitchen have cooked Punjabi, Iraqi, Sri Lankan, Nepalese and Iranian food.

q: Do you offer vegetarian and vegan options?
a: All our takeaway food is vegan. Please let us know if you have any allergies or other dietary requirements.

q: How do I make an order?
a: We cook fortnightly on Fridays during school term times (most of the chefs have children to look after). You can order here and pay on PayPal, or email us on ammiskitchensheffield@gmail.com and pay on pick up by cash or card. We take orders up until 5pm on the Tuesday before we cook.

q: What are your takeaway / delivery options?
a:
We offer three options for the Ammi's Kitchen takeaway - each option has its own PayPal link in the Order Takeaway section:

  1. Pick up at Common Ground and BYO packaging (tiffin or three containers)
  2. Pick up at Common Ground and use our packaging
  3. Delivered in our packaging

q: What dates are you running the takeaway?
a:
Ammi's Kitchen takeaway is fortnightly on Fridays during term times. The takeaways in the New Year will be on:

  • Jan - 16th and 30th
  • Feb - 13th and 27th
  • March - 13th and 27th
  • April - 24th
  • May - 8th and 22nd
  • June - 12th and 26th
  • July - 10th

q: Do Ammi's Kitchen sell their food at any other times?
a: Yes. Ammi's Kitchen run a community lunch at Common Ground, Woodstock Road, S7 1HA on alternate Fridays to the takeaway. Everyone is welcome for lunch. It is free if on benefits / NRPF or pay as you feel.
